identifiedBy.fact: party climbed the NE buttress (class 3) after starting at Onion Valley, Kearsarge Pass, JMT to Bubbs Creek, up Vidette Creek

otherFacts.value: Kearsarge Pass 4.7 mi, ~2600 ft gain from Onion Valley
NE buttress class 3; NE ridge class 3-4; summit section class 2-3

identifiedBy.fact: Burd 2007 trip: South Lake, Bishop Pass, LeConte Canyon, Rambaud Pass, NW Arete

notes: Moderate: 'Standard route' assumed to be the NW Arete (the commonly named standard). SummitPost 403. Search summaries say South Lake or Ladder Lake are used as starts; South Lake is the one an opened page states. USFS point is 15.2 km from peak.

identifiedBy.fact: Start at the Pioneer Gulch trailhead and follow the Pioneer Gulch Trail

notes: Name from route text. No opened page gave a coordinate; oregonhikers thread only mentions the Pioneer Gulch trail junction. Empty placements: needs OSM name match. Not the sibling's Summit Lake TH.

Search summaries only: Bayview and Eagle Falls (Emerald Bay) both commonly used (Eagle Falls north-ridge class 2 log; Bayview to Dicks Pass); also Glen Alpine. No opened page defines a standard route start. Two or more equal starts, so stuck. Leads: USFS Bayview 38.943878,-120.099979.

Search summary of SummitPost (403 on open) says the peak is most easily reached from Glacier Lodge / Big Pine Creek trailhead and the standard route needs the Middle Palisade Glacier bergschrund. Not opened, so weak; Big Pine South Fork vs North Fork unresolved. Lead only: USFS BIG PINE CREEK SO FORK TH 37.124805,-118.438913.

identifiedBy.fact: Downey Creek trail leads to Bachelor Creek trail; the route's own descent exits via Cub Lake, Cub Pass, Bachelor Creek; search summaries of Mountaineers Dome Glacier page and a 2011 Cascade Climbers report give the same Downey Creek approach (not opened, 403)

summitEvidence.fact: technical climbing ends just below the top, a short scramble reaches the summit

otherFacts.value: Suiattle River Rd closed at milepost 10.5 per WTA (route text says MP 4-4.5)

notes: Medium: Downey Creek is the standard Dome Glacier / Cub Lake approach; the route's 'Ptarmigan Traverse western approach' wording is off. Closure milepost conflict stands. Cascade Climbers and Mountaineers 403.
